description: This file defines an abstract class 'Data' in the Drupal JSON:API module, representing top-level 'data' and 'included' objects, with methods for managing collections of resource identifiers, including merging and deduplication.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: An abstract class representing JSON:API data collections, supporting iteration, counting, merging, and deduplication of resource identifier objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Data collection with resource identifiers and optional cardinality.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the resource identifiers.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of resource identifiers.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of entities.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total count of entities.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the collection as an array of resource identifiers.

methods.name: hasNextPage
methods.description: Checks if there is a next page in the collection.

methods.name: setHasNextPage
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating if there is a next page.

methods.name: getCardinality
methods.description: Returns the cardinality of the collection.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges two Data objects into a new one.

methods.name: deduplicate
methods.description: Deduplicates a Data collection based on resource type and ID, with special handling for access denied exceptions.
